note: All templates are scoped to {domain}. Use only on assets you own or are authorized to assess.

dorks.title: Open directory listings
dorks.template: site:{domain} intitle:"index of" "parent directory"
dorks.why: Autoindex exposes file trees, often with backups and uploads.
dorks.fix: Disable autoindex; add index files; restrict paths.

dorks.title: Exposed .git directories
dorks.template: site:{domain} inurl:".git" intitle:"index of"
dorks.why: Repo history can leak source and secrets.
dorks.fix: Block dotfiles at the server; never deploy VCS dirs; rotate any leaked secrets.

dorks.title: Backup and temp files
dorks.template: site:{domain} (ext:bak OR ext:old OR ext:backup OR ext:orig OR ext:swp OR ext:tmp)
dorks.why: Backups of source/config are served as plain text or downloads.
dorks.fix: Remove from webroot; add CI check for stray backup extensions.

dorks.title: Database dumps
dorks.template: site:{domain} (ext:sql OR ext:dump OR ext:db) "INSERT INTO"
dorks.why: Dumps contain user data and hashes.
dorks.fix: Remove; store dumps off-box and encrypted; rotate credentials.

dorks.title: Environment files
dorks.template: site:{domain} ext:env ("APP_KEY" OR "DB_PASSWORD" OR "SECRET")
dorks.why: .env files hold credentials and API keys.
dorks.fix: Block at server; move secrets to a secrets manager; rotate.

dorks.title: Configuration files
dorks.template: site:{domain} (ext:conf OR ext:cnf OR ext:cfg OR ext:ini OR ext:xml OR ext:yml OR ext:yaml) (password OR secret OR token)
dorks.why: Config files may include connection strings and tokens.
dorks.fix: Keep config outside webroot; template secrets at runtime.

dorks.title: Log files
dorks.template: site:{domain} ext:log
dorks.why: Logs leak paths, usernames, session IDs, and errors.
dorks.fix: Store logs outside webroot; restrict access.

dorks.title: phpinfo() pages
dorks.template: site:{domain} ext:php intitle:phpinfo "published by the PHP Group"
dorks.why: Reveals versions, paths, and environment variables.
dorks.fix: Delete the page.

dorks.title: WordPress config backups
dorks.template: site:{domain} inurl:wp-config (ext:bak OR ext:old OR ext:txt OR ext:save)
dorks.why: Exposes DB credentials and salts.
dorks.fix: Remove; rotate DB password and salts.

dorks.title: Documents marked confidential/internal
dorks.template: site:{domain} (ext:pdf OR ext:doc OR ext:docx OR ext:xls OR ext:xlsx OR ext:ppt OR ext:pptx) (confidential OR "internal use only" OR "not for distribution")
dorks.why: Internal material published by mistake.
dorks.fix: Remove; move behind auth; request de-indexing.

dorks.title: Spreadsheets with personal data
dorks.template: site:{domain} (ext:csv OR ext:xls OR ext:xlsx) (email OR phone OR "date of birth")
dorks.why: Possible PII exposure and regulatory impact (GDPR etc.).
dorks.fix: Remove; assess breach-notification obligations.

dorks.title: Published PDFs for metadata review
dorks.template: site:{domain} ext:pdf
dorks.why: Metadata can reveal usernames, software, internal paths.
dorks.fix: Strip metadata before publishing (exiftool -all=).

dorks.title: Admin and login panels
dorks.template: site:{domain} (inurl:admin OR inurl:login OR inurl:signin OR inurl:dashboard)
dorks.why: Indexed admin interfaces ease targeting and brute force.
dorks.fix: Restrict by IP/VPN/SSO; enforce MFA; noindex.

dorks.title: DevOps dashboards
dorks.template: site:{domain} (intitle:"Jenkins" OR intitle:"Grafana" OR intitle:"Kibana" OR intitle:"Prometheus")
dorks.why: Unauthenticated dashboards leak infra details or allow actions.
dorks.fix: Require authentication; place behind VPN.

dorks.title: API documentation endpoints
dorks.template: site:{domain} (inurl:swagger OR inurl:api-docs OR intitle:"Swagger UI" OR inurl:openapi)
dorks.why: Reveals endpoints and parameters, including internal ones.
dorks.fix: Restrict docs to authorized users; separate internal APIs.

dorks.title: Staging/dev/test hosts
dorks.template: site:{domain} (inurl:staging OR inurl:dev OR inurl:test OR inurl:uat OR inurl:qa)
dorks.why: Non-prod often has weaker controls and real data.
dorks.fix: Put behind auth; don't use production data.

dorks.title: Verbose error messages
dorks.template: site:{domain} ("SQL syntax" OR "Fatal error" OR "Stack trace" OR "Traceback (most recent call last)" OR "Warning: mysql")
dorks.why: Stack traces leak code paths, frameworks, and queries.
dorks.fix: Disable debug mode; use generic error pages.

dorks.title: Indexed subdomains
dorks.template: site:*.{domain} -www
dorks.why: Find forgotten or shadow-IT hosts.
dorks.fix: Reconcile against inventory; decommission unknowns.

dorks.title: Email addresses on third-party sites
dorks.template: "@{domain}" -site:{domain}
dorks.why: Shows where staff emails are exposed (phishing targeting).
dorks.fix: Use role aliases; request removal where appropriate.

dorks.title: Domain mentioned on paste sites
dorks.template: site:pastebin.com "{domain}"
dorks.why: Pastes may contain leaked data or credentials tied to you.
dorks.fix: Report to the paste site; rotate affected credentials.

dorks.title: Domain next to secrets in public code
dorks.template: site:github.com "{domain}" (password OR secret OR token OR api_key)
dorks.why: Developers commit credentials and internal URLs.
dorks.fix: Rotate; remove via history rewrite; enable secret scanning.

dorks.title: Public cloud storage naming your domain
dorks.template: (site:s3.amazonaws.com OR site:blob.core.windows.net OR site:storage.googleapis.com) "{domain}"
dorks.why: Open buckets leak files at scale.
dorks.fix: Enable account-level public access block; audit policies/ACLs.

dorks.title: Public Trello/Jira boards mentioning you
dorks.template: (site:trello.com OR site:atlassian.net) "{domain}"
dorks.why: Public boards often hold internal plans and credentials.
dorks.fix: Set boards private; rotate anything pasted.

dorks.title: Login pages mimicking your brand elsewhere
dorks.template: intitle:"{domain}" (login OR "sign in") -site:{domain}
dorks.why: Detects possible phishing or clones.
dorks.fix: Takedown requests; add to mail/web blocklists.
